analysis.narrativeEn:

· vs SMA100 (KRW 248,190) / SMA200 (KRW 237,838): below mid-to-long term, maintaining weak trend strength.

· MACD histogram trajectory (-450.3665→23.6881): attempting to exit bottoming phase, improvement confirmed.
· Bollinger Bands current price position (Middle Band KRW 209,685): band width expanding to 28.57% then contracting.
[Support & Resistance Structure]

· Swing Resistance (KRW 209,000): resistance zone based on SMA20, potential trend reversal upon breakout.
· 5-day/20-day High/Low Pattern (Sideways): no clear trend formation, maintaining range-bound.
[Volume & Conclusion]
· Volume Ratio (0.77x): below average volume, reduced reliability of movement.
· Current phase diagnosis (Accumulation Phase): lack of direction, maintaining wait-and-see conditions.
